gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of primary triple negative breast carcinoma (TNBC).

candidate_evidence.quote: Intradermal vaccination with peptide-pulsed autologous dendritic cells in 200 µL of patient's serum in six doses, one weekly after surgery.

role_evidence.quote: Intradermal vaccination with peptide-pulsed autologous dendritic cells in 200 µL of patient's serum in six doses, one weekly after surgery.

agents.drug_class_hint: personalised neoantigen peptide-pulsed autologous dendritic cell vaccine

coder_notes: Triple-negative breast cancer trial; glioblastoma appears only in the brief summary as a possible future target, so not eligible population. Tumour neoantigens are individualised vaccine targets, not registered biomarkers.
